{{Top|leg}}
'''Dihexalon gas''', deadly to most life-forms, was used to create biochemical weapons. Developed during the years leading up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it saw limited use in battle.

In [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]], it was used to create a [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]] which the crimelord "[[Granta Omega|Striker]]" (an alias of [[Granta Omega]]) attempted to unleash on the planet [[Mawan/Legends|Mawan]].
